segs.en: I. I Don't Miss Pennies

zh.ai: I. 我不在乎便士

segs.en: In November 2025, the United States minted its last pennies (one-cent coins). Canada has not minted pennies since 2012.

zh.ai: 2025 年 11 月，美国铸造了最后一批便士（一美分硬币）。加拿大自 2012 年起便不再铸造便士。

segs.en: Billions of pennies remain in circulation, but pennies are expected to fade from circulation over time. Stores are expected to continue to price items to the cent, as credit card transactions are processed to the cent. However, for cash transactions, stores are expected to round to the nearest nickel (five cents). Specifically, if the final digit of a total purchase ends in $$$3$$$, $$$4$$$, $$$8$$$ or $$$9$$$ cents, the total will be rounded up; if it ends in $$$1$$$, $$$2$$$, $$$6$$$ or $$$7$$$ cents, it will be rounded down. Transactions ending in $$$0$$$ or $$$5$$$ cents are not rounded.

zh.ai: 数十亿枚便士仍在流通，但预计便士会逐渐退出流通。商店预计仍会将商品价格精确到美分，因为信用卡交易会精确处理到美分。然而，对于现金交易，商店预计会将总额四舍五入到最接近的五美分。具体而言，如果一次购买的总金额最后一位是 $$$3$$$、$$$4$$$、$$$8$$$ 或 $$$9$$$ 美分，则总额向上取整；如果最后一位是 $$$1$$$、$$$2$$$、$$$6$$$ 或 $$$7$$$ 美分，则总额向下取整。以 $$$0$$$ 或 $$$5$$$ 美分结尾的交易金额不进行取整。

segs.en: You realize that this provides an opportunity. If you pay cash and rearrange and group your purchases appropriately, you may be able to pay slightly less for everything you buy! Given the prices of the individual items you wish to buy in cents, determine the maximum amount you could save by paying solely in cash and rearranging and grouping your purchases optimally, compared to the non-rounded total price you would pay if you bought all of the items with a credit card.

zh.ai: 你意识到这提供了一个机会。如果你使用现金支付，并适当地重新安排和组合你的购买，你可能能够以略低的价格买下所有商品！给定你想购买的各个商品的价格（以美分为单位），请确定：与使用信用卡购买所有商品时需要支付的未舍入总价相比，仅使用现金支付并最优地重新安排和组合购买时，最多可以节省多少钱。

segs.en: The first line of input contains a single integer $$$N$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 3 \cdot 10^{5}$$$), the number of items you intend to purchase.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$($$$1 \le N \le 3 \cdot 10^{5}$$$)，表示你打算购买的物品数量。

segs.en: The next line contains $$$N$$$ space-separated integers $$$p_i$$$ ($$$1\le p_i\le 3\,000$$$), the prices of the items in cents.

zh.ai: 下一行包含 $$$N$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $$$p_i$$$($$$1\le p_i\le 3\,000$$$)，表示各物品的价格，单位为美分。

segs.en: Print a single integer: the difference between the total credit card price without rounding and the lowest total cost that can be obtained by paying cash and grouping purchases optimally.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数：未进行取整时的信用卡总价，与通过现金支付并最优分组购买所能得到的最低总费用之间的差。

segs.en: Explanation of Sample Input 1

zh.ai: 样例输入 1 的解释

segs.en: For the first sample, one optimal grouping of items is $$\{78, 999, 350\}, \{59, 173, 2995, 350\}, \{882, 298\}, \{1096\}, \{497\}.$$ The prices of each group are, respectively, $$$1427, 3577, 1180, 1096, 497$$$ and thus the total difference is $$(1427 + 3577 + 1180 + 1096 + 497) - (1425 + 3575 + 1180 + 1095 + 495) = 7.$$ You save $$$7$$$ cents by optimally grouping the items into several cash transactions instead of paying for everything with a credit card.
M. Binary String Counting 2026

zh.ai: M. 二进制字符串计数 2026

segs.en: Yes, this is yet another problem about counting binary strings.

zh.ai: 是的，这又是一道关于计数二进制字符串的题目。

segs.en: You are given a string $$$s$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ characters; each character is either 1 or 0. Also, you are given an integer $$$k$$$.

zh.ai: 给定一个由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串 $$$s$$$；每个字符要么是 1，要么是 0。此外，给定一个整数 $$$k$$$。

segs.en: You can perform up to $$$k$$$ (possibly zero) operations on string $$$s$$$. Each operation has to be of one of three types:

zh.ai: 你可以对字符串 $$$s$$$ 执行至多 $$$k$$$ 次(也可以是零次)操作。每次操作必须属于以下三种类型之一：

segs.en: choose an index $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and replace $$$s_i$$$ with its inverse (that is, if $$$s_i$$$ is 1, replace it with 0, and vice versa);

zh.ai: 选择一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的下标 $$$i$$$，并将 $$$s_i$$$ 替换为其相反值(即若 $$$s_i$$$ 为 1，则将其替换为 0，反之亦然)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-descending order (assuming that 1 is greater than 0);

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 的字符按非递减顺序排序(假设 1 大于 0)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-ascending order (also assuming that 1 is greater than 0).

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 中的字符按非升序排序(并规定 1 大于 0)。

segs.en: String $$$t$$$ is reachable if it is possible to obtain it from $$$s$$$ by applying no more than $$$k$$$ operations. You have to calculate the number of reachable strings $$$t$$$.
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 150$$$; $$$0 \le k \le n$$$).
The second line contains $$$s$$$ — a string consisting of exactly $$$n$$$ characters. Each character is either 1 or 0.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$s$$$ —— 一个恰好由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串。每个字符都是 1 或 0。

segs.en: Print one integer — the number of reachable strings. Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数——可达字符串的数量。由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
